trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of the 3-item remark. The triple is substantive (it mirrors the .ts title's three named points). trap-negation-contrast.notes: Clean on all ten. MATH FINDING (report, not fixed): item 2's genus set is wrong. A faithful Z_5 on the hyperelliptic curve descends to an order-5 automorphism of P^1 with exactly two fixed points, so the branch divisor has n = 5a + e points with e in {0,1,2}, and n = 2g+2 must be even. Solving gives attainable genera {2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 10, 12, ...}: g=4 needs n=10 (a=2,e=0), g=5 needs n=12 (a=2,e=2), g=7 needs n=16 (a=3,e=1). g=6 would need n=14, and 14, 13, 12 are none of them divisible by 5, so g=6 is NOT attainable (nor is g=8, n=18). The text's 'yielding genera g in {4,5,6,...}' should read {4,5,7,...}. The block's own g=4 'two size-5 orbits' example is correct.
